positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed and managed the daemon process that facilitates installations and upgrades of IBM APIConnect on a Kubernetes cluster on an Ubuntu VMWare appliance.
- Developed and owned the procedure of migrating our VMWare customers from our legacy Cassandra based product to the new Postgres based version using Python.
- Automated migration procedure of moving from Helm2 to Helm3 for VMWare customers.
- Developed and owned procedure of moving customers from Ubuntu 16.04 to Ubuntu 20.04 installations using Python.
- Developed functionalities using gRPC for communication between nodes in an appliance installation.
-  Developed CLI tools to be used for installation/upgrades/maintenance/monitoring of an appliance installation of IBM APIConnect.
- Developed and maintained CICD pipeline automation to test various upgrade paths of the product using Jenkins and Groovy.
- Led enterprise customer demos and support calls
- Maintained currency of our appliance control-plane by upgrading Kubernetes, Helm, and other dependencies every release cycle.
- Implemented unit tests in Golang
- Technologies: Golang, Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, Groovy, Python, JFrog Artifactory

positions.title: Lab Coordinator
positions.description: I screened and approved of applicants to become Lab Tutors and managed them throughout each quarter. I ensured every lab ran smoothly with professional tutors and Teaching Assistants. I also managed the tutor website to provide useful learning resources and tutoring information to the Computer Science students of UCI. My goal was that every student in the Donald Bren School of ICS has a valuable learning experience in their labs.

company.name: UC Irvine Donald Bren School of Information and Computer Sciences

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
My team and I were responsible for creating a Command Line Interface for IBM Cloud Object Storage utilizing Golang and the AWS GO SDK as a plugin for the existing Bluemix CLI. I utilized and modified the AWS S3 API to perform necessary REST calls with IBM Cloud Object Storage to perform Bucket and Object operations. In parallel with the implementation, my team created an extensive functional testing suite using Golang testing utilities to ensure consistency and robustness. 

An AGILE methodology was used throughout the project before handing the project after the end of the internship to a Cloud Team of developers to be prepared for production.

positions.title: AppJam+ Program Mentor
positions.description: Dreams for Schools oversees programs and initiatives that contribute to educating youth about Science, Technology, Engineering & Math (STEM) fields. The main outreach program of the organization is the AppJam+ initiative. AppJam+ is a program that takes the concept of building software in a short period of time and uses it as a tool to excite and inform middle school students about STEM fields while teaching them the creative and hands-on technical process of mobile application development. Middle school students receive mentorship from college undergraduates and learn to make Mobile apps, which will be utilized by early learners.

positions.title: Manufacturing and Production Intern
positions.description: Primarily my responsibilities consisted of working with another intern to utilize Excel Macros and Microsoft VBA to create scripts that would simplify data entry and data management. I also observed and recorded data on production speeds and scrap quantities to produce trend lines that would outline areas of improvement in productivity/efficiency. Furthermore, I designed and created a new rework/scrap log that is more readable and organized for workers.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: ASUCI | Associated Students of University of California, Irvine
volunteerExperiences.description: I communicated with a group of motivated individuals to organize campus-wide events that support various causes such as cancer awareness and environmental conservation. Anteaters in Action strives to stimulate the entire student body to participate in these events for maximum support as well as to unite the campus toward well-deserved causes.
